text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon watched Narita Brian run 
alongside Symboli Rudolf. She was 
awestruck by their running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, Hishi Amazon ran in a mock race, 
but haunted by the image of their running, 
she was defeated... She felt a burning 
frustration at her own lack of strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants strength on par with Narita 
Brian. Hishi Amazon decides that if Brian 
goes for the Triple Crown, she will claim 
the Triple Tiara instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wanted to have a true one-on-one duel 
at the Arima Kinen someday... With that 
desire in her heart, Hishi Amazon decided 
to head for the Oka Sho.
